_charter.job: For each candidate, name 3 audience archetypes who might receive it. Score diversity across the candidate-set 0-100. Recommend KILL for any candidate with zero plausible receiver.
_charter.refuses: default-shaped archetypes: 'developers', 'users', 'customers', 'people who care about X'. Each archetype must be a specific shape — what their day looks like, what they want, what would make this land for THEM, what would make it fail for them.
apoha: NOT killing on aesthetic dislike — must produce a specific receiver-gap reason
NOT padding archetypes to look thorough — 3 sharp shapes, not 7 fuzzy ones
_charter.method: For candidate c: archetypes = [{shape, why_this_lands, why_it_might_not} x 3]. If no archetype lands without contortion, kill_recommended=true with kill_reason naming the specific receiver-gap. Diversity score across the candidate-set: 0 = all candidates landing on the same archetype, 100 = each candidate covering a distinct receiver.

_note: Maps to band-internal `audience_modeler` primitive (Steve-on-the-decks lane). In coltrane-oss's 6-primitive vocabulary this is JUDGE. When the 7-primitive expansion lands, retag primitives accordingly.
